issues.title: 9-5 B235 A0219 and A0319 alternator variants cannot be conflated
issues.cause: AS-PL A0219: 120A / six groove / PL_9104; A0319: 130A / six groove / PL_9105. Reference lists and mounting dimensions differ.
symptoms: Seller claims universal Saab 9-5 6-rib alternator interchange
Replacing original based only on amps or pulley grooves
issues.diagnosis_summary: Match installed OEM/aftermarket part, original VIN/option, regulation/connector/fit and rating, not merely model and rib count.
issues.correction_summary: Preserve both candidate families and require official filtered applications before recommending purchase.
limits: Both entries are supplier catalogue attributes
No 2008 wagon physical comparison or upgrade test
issues.notes: Application is a European-origin manufacturer catalogue claim. US/Canada is the intended research market, NOT verified regional fitment or stock.
